<!-- agent-note:v1 --> Lane code-p, task 13936: handed off to opencode claimant per 1b (lane row 5291). Issue #5876 verified OPEN via REST 2026-11-09, no hard-stop labels. Claimant launches bound session.

## Decision record: residency evidence model (DECIDED, task 13936)

Status: **DECIDED by this comment + `doc/2026-11-09_design_id5876_residency_evidence_model.md`** (PR #7962). Design only; implementation timing remains a separate decision per the issue framing.

### Chosen shape
- **Declaration record:** subject + claim type (`residency`/`citizenship`) + one jurisdiction value + assurance level + provenance (declarant, verifier/trust root, basis reference, `verified_at`) + lifetime (`expires_at` mandatory, `serial`) + visibility class. Multi-jurisdiction subjects hold multiple declarations. Maps onto the `residency.rs` `Evidence{issuer, source, serial, signature, expires_at}` the evaluator already enforces.
- **Assurance (ordered):** L0 self-declared < L1 org-attested < L2 document/provider-verified. Higher satisfies lower, never reverse. Public-IP observations (#5877) sit below L0: corroboration/step-up only, never a declaration.
- **Provenance:** declarant, verifier identity (trust root), basis reference (never raw documents), `verified_at`, `serial`. Untrusted issuers and peer self-assertions presented as third-party evidence deny (signature proves authorship, not location — the #3398 rule, unchanged).
- **Lifetime:** mandatory expiry; renewal = new superseding declaration; revocation via `EvidenceVerifier::revoked(serial)` denies immediately. Expired/revoked denies new grants and re-evaluates existing access at the next enforcement point — no silent grandfathering. Denials are logged as new audit entries (#5883 pattern) stating what would restore access.
- **Visibility:** boolean-by-default (`satisfies boundary S: yes/no` to checkers/peers); exact values only to the subject + deciding scope's admin; scope-local storage, no global registry; audit cites classes/levels, never raw values; raw identity documents never stored.

### Alternatives rejected (why)
Bare boolean flag (collapses assurance, unauditable); global registry (the dossier the parent forbids); raw document storage (unnecessary, creates a target); auto-promotion of assurance (weak evidence must never silently satisfy strong boundaries); indefinite lifetime (stale facts persist); exact-value-to-every-checker (every enforcement point becomes a dossier copy); IP-alone as declaration (re-decides #5877 — not forked here).

### Invariants
Opt-in only/default off; ordered assurance with no auto-promotion; provenance + mandatory expiry on every declaration; expiry/revocation enforced at every check incl. re-checks/retries; boolean-by-default visibility; scope-local storage with class-level audit; untrusted-issuer denies; every denial/step-up states the evidence classes used and what would change the outcome.

### Parent divergence / splits
